verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs describe a single consistent platform (git-push deploys, same environment model for local/preview/production, zero-config framework support, Fluid compute that scales concurrency for AI/I/O workloads) suggesting the same core primitives apply from prototype to production. However, there's no explicit case study or documentation proving indefinite scaling to 'massive scale' without added complexity, and community evidence notes some scaling-related capabilities (e.g., secure DB connections) are gated behind 'contact sales'/enterprise tiers, implying not all primitives are uniformly available at every scale tier. missing for 10: explicit prototype-to-massive-scale case study/benchmark, confirmation that enterprise-tier features (security, DB pooling) are available without a distinct migration path, independent scale-testing evidence.
